note: Only the 150M experiment is implemented in Revision 9.1.2. The 300M/500M/750M targets are unchanged and deferred.

tokenizer.eos_convention: cl100k <|endoftext|> appended after every document; document boundaries are preserved in the packed stream
tokenizer.vocab_note: 100,256 ordinary mergeable tokens + special/reserved ids up to 100,277; the model embedding and output layers use 100,278 rows so every valid cl100k token id is representable

architecture.attention: causal self-attention via SDPA (memory-efficient/math backend on T4; T4 SM75 has no FlashAttention kernels)
architecture.parameter_budget_note: 150,580,452 parameters (verified by instantiation and printed at run start) = 73,403,496 (tied embedding 100,278 x 732, counted once) + 12 layers x 6,431,352 (4*732^2 attention + 2*732*2928 MLP + 2*732 RMSNorm) + 732 (final norm); +0.387% vs 150,000,000, inside the +/-0.5% requirement. The trainer prints the exact count before allocating the optimizer and aborts outside the range.

data.validation_holdout: none (full selection used for training; documented)
data.contamination_quarantine: SWE-bench Verified vs SWE-rebench-V2 and Terminal-Bench vs Nemotron-Pivot ran with 0 overlaps in Revision 9.1.1; applies to later agent-stage training

training.precision: FP16 mixed precision + gradient scaling on CUDA (GradScaler); CPU fallback uses bfloat32 autocast for smoke tests only
training.gradient_checkpointing: on by default for GPU runs (torch.utils.checkpoint) to fit the T4's 14.5 GiB budget; disabled on CPU; can be toggled in build_model(grad_checkpoint=)
training.tokens_planned_note: 6,103 steps x 491,520 tokens = 2,999,746,560 tokens consumed in one deterministic pass (~3.0B, within one step of the 3B budget; the exact step count is computed from the verified stream at run time)

checkpoint_policy.resume_validation: parameter count, vocab/EOS, and data-manifest hash must match; corrupt or mismatched checkpoints are rejected and the previous known-good is used
